IngestAck.description: The server's answer to a batch.

server_time.description: unix seconds, server clock. Lets a handset correct drift without a time API — timestamps decide the staleness window, so a phone six minutes fast reports nothing that counts.

stop.description: Stop uploading and stop sensing. Set when the session has ended or the disclosure this report cites is no longer served. A phone that keeps sensing after the event is a battery complaint and a privacy problem.
